chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family (SAWW), said:
"Whoever dies on the day of Jumu'ah or the night of Jumu'ah, Allah will lift from him the punishment of the grave."

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for someone who dies on the day or night of Jumu'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a special grace for one who dies on the day or night of Jumu'ah, namely relief from the punishment of the grave. It highlights the blessed status of Jumu'ah and points to realities of the afterlife and barzakh.
